assumptions.choice: Main session assumed from 09:30 to 16:00 EST with ORB window defined as 09:30-10:30 (first 60 mins).
assumptions.reason: Standard US equities trading hours fit the 5-minute bar dataset context.

assumptions.choice: Defined pullback to Fib zone as bar intersecting range [ORL + 0.382*R, ORL + 0.618*R] with close > open (long) or close < open (short).
assumptions.reason: Literal translation of bounce bar occurring within/from the Fib range specified.

assumptions.choice: Set ATR trailing stop multiplier to 1.5.
assumptions.reason: Spec states multiplier range 1.0–1.5; 1.5 provides conservative trailing protection.

assumptions.choice: Defined morning trade as any trade entered before 13:30.
assumptions.reason: Aligns with the specification separating London/morning window (<12:00 / early day) from New York afternoon window (after 13:30).
